text.description_html:
Acorn RTPBR Bean Tip Rim Latch For Extra Thick Gates

This Bean Rim Latch is for Gates 3 Inches Thick. It has a rough black iron finish that is rustic looking--a great choice for county gates on stables and between pastures. This Gate Rim Latch is felid reversible to work on right hand of left hand doors that are either in swing out swing.

Rough Black Iron: A rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the naturally weathered iron.

Features and Specifications for the Bean Tip Privacy Rim Latchset for 3 Inch Thick Gate:

  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Handle Height: 9-5/8"
  • Handle Width: 3-13/16"
  • Door Thickness: 3"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold as a set.
